text: Uh, im going to assume you just removed the collision with the ground because i fell thru the map. ???
resolution: Fixed the fall-through I introduced in the baked-collider branch of world_loader.buildPhysicsColliders. My first cut rebuilt walkable floor colliders ONLY from instance rows AFTER the pieces (row >= scene.piece_count), on the assumption the ground was always the painted floor. But a built floor PLATE is a PIECE (row < piece_count), so its walkable rect was never derived and the player dropped through. Rewrote the branch to be a strict superset of the pre-bake instance collision: iterate ALL instance rows and reproduce the old behavior (non-solid -> walkable rect for built floor plates AND painted ground cells; non-piece solid -> solid rect; non-piece ramp -> heightfield), skipping ONLY piece SOLIDS (rows < piece_count, sy > step height) because those authored walls are replaced by the +-join baked colliders (the invisible-wall fix). Relief ground stays a heightfield (registered before the branch); piece ramps stay baked heightfields. Net: nothing that was standable before can fall through, while walls still use the editor's authored colliders. Zig ast-check clean. Still needs a full rebuild + map re-Compile to confirm in-game. Nothing committed.
